name: UDSM ARIS 3 v1.4.3
body:
## Update flow + download reliability + versioned app name

- "Download update" now opens the download page (with install steps) instead of a raw APK link; a secondary "Open APK link directly" action is available if the page cannot be reached.
- Fixed the update button doing nothing on Android 11+: the app declares a browser it is allowed to launch, launches it directly instead of pre-checking, and copies the link with a message if no browser can be opened — silent dead clicks are gone.
- The download page now streams the APK on the page itself with a progress bar, automatic resume when the connection drops, and a verified size before hand-off. The file lands as `aris3-v1.4.3.apk`, so a complete download is distinguishable from a broken one — no more downloads that stick at 100% without finishing.
- Launcher name now carries the running version ("Aris3 v1.4.3").
- Update-check manifest bumped to 1.4.3 — older builds gate to this release on next start.
